question.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix 
$P=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 1 \\ 1 & -5\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $P-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
P-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-5-\lambda  & 1 \\ 1 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(P-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(P-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-5-\lambda  & 1 \\ 1 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-5-\lambda )(-5-\lambda )-1\cdot 1 & =0 \\ 25+5\lambda +5\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}-1 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+10\lambda +24 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quadratic formula, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\lambda  & =\frac{-10\pm \sqrt{{10}^{2}-4\cdot 1\cdot 24}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-10\pm \sqrt{4}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-10\pm 2}{2} \\  & =-6,-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =-6$ and $\lambda =-4.$
